updateMessage: CineVault 3.1.0 Studio Edition is required. Update to continue enjoying smooth 120Hz streaming, upgraded video player gestures, and curated discovery.
changelog: All-new premium Apple TV / Max tier studio design system
Upgraded Video Player with tactile brightness & volume HUD capsules
Interactive scrub timeline with glowing thumb and live time bubble
Curated 10-category genre discovery tiles replacing tag cloud
120Hz buttery smooth scrolling and composite-thread tab transitions
Docked floating mini-player bar above navigation dock
Mandatory upgrade required for all users (v3.0.0 and below) to ensure uninterrupted streaming
